verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer docs list a first-party Webhooks page for the QuickBooks Workforce API. It is described as a way to stay informed whenever a connected company runs payroll or adds or updates an employee (snippet truncated), which covers the payroll-processed and likely employee-onboarded events. The evidence is only an llms.txt index snippet, and it never mentions payment-failed events or subscription and payload details. Missing for 10: evidence of payment-failed events, a documented event catalog with subscription/registration and payload details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
